description: This file defines the 'PurgeCandidateModel' class within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin API. It models a data structure for representing a candidate marked for purging, specifically containing a vacancy ID. The class implements a 'Normalizable' interface to serialize its data for API responses.

classes.name: PurgeCandidateModel
classes.description: Represents a model for a purge candidate with a specific vacancy ID, used in the maintenance API.
